worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.summary: The user plants itself, raises both claws and rips a crossing pair of giant claw marks across a whole fan in front: every enemy in the arc is caught, and each struck target has its armour torn open and its Defence lowered. It is the family's only move that weakens armour and the only one that sweeps a whole area at once.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.0: Rake a whole fan in front with both claws at once
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.1: Catch several foes in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.2: Tear a target's armour open and lower its Defence
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.description: A %3$s degree fan reaching about %2$s blocks, each claw dealing about %1$s contact damage.
The fan is about %1$s blocks tall; a caught target loses %2$s Defence stages.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.cross.on: Cross form: the fan widens from 84 to %1$s degrees and tears %2$s armour stages, each claw about %3$s damage, but with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.cross.off: Single-claw form: a narrower front (%1$s degrees) and %2$s armour stages, each claw about %3$s damage, with a faster wind-up and shorter cycle.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.growth.0: At level %1$s each claw rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.growth.1: At level %1$s each claw rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
On (cross): the base fan angle goes from 84 to 140 degrees, 2 armour stages torn and a wider sweep, at the cost of power ×0.9, +3 ticks of wind-up and +6 of cooldown. Off (single claw): a narrower front (base 84 degrees) but ×1.06 damage per claw, 1 armour stage, and a faster wind-up and cycle.
